steps.name: pomodoro-1-pure-core
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -f apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h -a -f apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c -a -f tools/host_pomodoro_test.py && grep -q pm_pos_step apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h && grep -q pm_restore apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c && ! grep -qE '#include +"orb' apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I apps/pomodoro -c apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c -o /dev/null && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations | tee /tmp/pomodoro1m.log && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/pomodoro1m.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/pomodoro1m.log

steps.name: pomodoro-2-app
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -f apps/pomodoro/main.c -a -f apps/pomodoro/version.txt && grep -qx v1.7.0 apps/pomodoro/version.txt && for s in orb_ring_set orb_ring_clear ORB_RING_BREATHE ORB_RING_FLASH ORB_RING_STEADY pm_restore pm_pos_step; do grep -q "$s" apps/pomodoro/main.c || { echo "missing $s"; exit 1; }; done && grep -q 'ORB_EXPORT("orb_push")' apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -q 'ORB_EXPORT("orb_service")' apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -q '"show": "none"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && python3 -c 'import json;import sys;s=json.load(open("apps/pomodoro/app.json"))["settings"];sys.exit(0 if len(s)==15 and sum(1 for x in s if x.get("show")=="none")==4 and all(x.get("help") and len(x["help"])>20 for x in s if x.get("show")!="none") and sorted(x["id"] for x in s if x["type"]=="color")==["col_focus","col_long","col_short"] else 1)' && python3 -c 'import sys;s=open("apps/pomodoro/main.c").read();b=s[s.index("orb_service"):];j=b.find("ORB_EXPORT",10);b=b[:j] if j>0 else b;bad=[n for n in ("orb_stage_","orb_cv_","orb_ui_","orb_blob_load") if n in b];print("orb_service names "+repr(bad) if bad else "orb_service draws nothing");sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)' && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations

steps.name: pomodoro-3-editor-looks
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -f apps/pomodoro/editor/editor.json -a -f apps/pomodoro/editor/pomodoro-bake.js -a -f apps/pomodoro/editor/pomodoro-editor.js -a -f apps/pomodoro/editor/_fixtures/schema-1.orbdesign -a -f apps/pomodoro/editor/_selftest/bake.html -a -f apps/pomodoro/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py && grep -q 'OrbHost.register' apps/pomodoro/editor/pomodoro-editor.js && grep -q '"schema": 1' apps/pomodoro/editor/editor.json && grep -q '"editor": "editor"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && grep -q '"os_min": "v9.9.9"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && awk '/STARTERS/{line=line $0} END{exit (line ~ /scope.*paper.*brass.*blueprint.*station.*celestial.*silver.*sectional/ && line !~ /vintage/) ? 0 : 1}' apps/pomodoro/editor/pomodoro-bake.js && export ORB_CHROME=/usr/bin/chromium && python3 apps/pomodoro/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py && python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py check-migrations apps/pomodoro && test $(ls $DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR/looks/*.png | wc -l) -ge 9 && test $(ls $DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR/states/*.png | wc -l) -ge 5 && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps && make check-editor

steps.name: pomodoro-4-ship
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; grep -q '"shelf": true' apps/pomodoro/app.json && grep -q '"os_min": "v9.9.9"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && test -f tools/orb-manager/apps/pomodoro.orbapp -a -f tools/orb-manager/themes/pomodoro-scope.orbtheme && grep -q 'pomodoro-scope.orbtheme' tools/rebake_shelf.py && grep -q 'bake_pomodoro' tools/rebake_shelf.py && grep -qE 'BAKE *=.*pomodoro' tools/rebake_shelf.py && grep -q '| \*\*Pomodoro\*\* |' docs/user-guide.md && python3 -c 'import sys;d=open("docs/user-guide.md").read();i=d.index("Press and turn");sys.exit(0 if "Pomodoro" in d[i:i+900] else 1)' && python3 tools/rebake_shelf.py --check && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps && make check-editor && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations
